title: ASG Content OS v2 — Skill I/O Envelope
description: Every Skill consumes and emits a JSON file conforming to this envelope. This is the n8n-readiness backbone: a node reads `input`, writes `output`, sets `status` + `next_skill`. No conversational dependency is permitted.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version. Bump only on breaking envelope changes.

skill.description: Skill name that produced this envelope, e.g. asg-strategic-filter.

skill_version.description: Semver of the Skill. v0.1 ships as 0.1.0.

run_id.description: Unique id for this pipeline run. Stable across all skills in one article's run.

article_id.description: Stable article identifier, e.g. ASG-044. For non-article skills (benchmarker, stock-auditor) use the task id, e.g. ASG-BM-2026W21 or ASG-AUDIT-001 (pattern relaxed by those skills' own io-schema).

stage.description: Which phase of the 28-step flow this skill belongs to.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC time this envelope was emitted.

status.description: ok = proceed to next_skill. modify = auto-fix then re-run same skill. flagged = proceed but human should look. blocked = hard stop, human decision required. error = skill failed to run.

next_skill.description: The skill the orchestrator (Claude Code now, n8n later) should run next. null = pipeline end or awaiting human.

human_gate.description: True if a Janson confirmation point applies before next_skill runs (the 4 mandatory confirmation points: Filter GO, Outline lock, Editorial Gate, Distribution).

library_refs.description: Every Library data point referenced by this skill, by ID. Editorial Gate verifies these resolve.

input.description: Skill-specific input. Shape defined by the skill's own io-schema.json under properties.input.

output.description: Skill-specific output. Shape defined by the skill's own io-schema.json under properties.output.

audit.description: Machine-readable trace for traceability and the feedback loop.

rulebook_refs.description: Rulebook sections this skill enforced, e.g. asg-publishing-gate.md#gate-6.
